name: Mosaic
author: Mateus Pym
description: Tile web apps such as Twitch, Kick, and YouTube as a mosaic on Hyprland, with video fullscreen kept inside each tile.

barWidget.description: Manage mosaic sessions: add a URL as a tile, focus or remove tiles, and close sessions.

schema.label: Browser
schema.description: A Chromium-family browser command to open tiles with, such as brave or ~/bin/my-browser. Leave empty to use the default browser, which must be Chromium-based.

schema.label: Hidden web apps
schema.description: Web app names or ids to leave out of the panel's buttons, separated by commas, for example: Tailscale, WhatsApp. Right-clicking a button adds it here. Hidden web apps can still be added by typing their name.
